results.body:
new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/ip/any")
                .withClientIp("0.0.0.0/0"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("ip-any-v4")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("any ipv4")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/ip/not")
                .withClientIp("!0.0.0.0/0"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("ip-not-v4")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("never")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/ip/v6")
                .withClientIp("::/0"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("ip-v6-all")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("ipv6 range")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/ip/doc")
                .withClientIp("[2001:db8::]/32"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("ip-v6-doc")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("never")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/ip/mapped")
                .withClientIp("!::ffff:0.0.0.0/96"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("ip-mapped-not")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("never")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/ip/plain")
                .withClientIp(" 0.0.0.0/0 "),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("ip-not-false")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("plain")
);
